create_SVC_break_ties: create an SVC classifier with break_ties=True and decision_function_shape='ovr' for multiclass tie-breaking
build_SVC_multiclass_classification: build a linear SVM classifier using SVC with kernel='linear' and C=1 on multiclass blob data
test_SVC_predict: test SVC.predict on a meshgrid of points to generate class prediction labels for decision boundary visualization
run_make_blobs_dataset: run make_blobs to generate synthetic multiclass training data with controlled random state
run_SVC_fit_predict: run SVC.fit on blob data then predict on a dense grid to visualize tie-breaking decision boundaries
